item.title: Victor Osimhen reveals his ‘rituals’ before playing any match

item.title: Arsenal’s 18-match unbeaten run ends at Aston Villa
item.description: Emiliano Buendia shattered Arsenal’s 18-match unbeaten run with the last-gasp strike that sealed Aston Villa’s dramatic 2-1 win over the Premier League leaders on Saturday. Mikel Arteta’s side fell behind to Matty Cash’s first half goal at Villa Park before Leandro Trossard came off the bench to equalise for Arsenal after the interval. item.description: An X user identified as Aunty Esther has faced criticism after announcing that she would not begin chemotherapy due to her religious beliefs as a Jehovah’s Witness.
